tagline: Global advisory firm specializing in M&A, restructuring, and private capital solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: The volume of announced mergers and acquisitions directly reflects PJT Partners' business activity as an M&A advisory firm and demonstrates its ability to generate revenue in a favorable market environment.

kpis.name: M&A Announced Volumes
kpis.explanation: The volume of announced mergers and acquisitions is a key indicator of the firm's activity.
kpis.description: Worldwide M&A announced volumes increased 49% in 2025 compared with 2024, however the number of transactions declined to a five-year low.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in announced M&A volumes in 2025 compared to 2024.

kpis.name: Cash and Cash Equivalents
kpis.explanation: Cash and cash equivalents represent liquid resources available to fund the company's operations and obligations.
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments were $585.8 million and $546.8 million, respectively.
kpis.signal: The company maintains robust liquidity to fund its operations and obligations.

kpis.name: M&A Announced Volumes
kpis.explanation: The volume of announced mergers and acquisitions is a key indicator of the firm's activity.
kpis.description: Worldwide M&A announced volumes increased 49% in 2025 compared with 2024. The broader capital markets and M&A environment continues to be favorable for deal making, with momentum in global M&A observed in the second half of 2025 likely to carry over through 2026.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in announced M&A volumes in 2025 compared to 2024, despite a decline in the number of transactions to a five-year low.
